EmailTemplate.subject: Join us in Supporting Sickle Cell Awareness Month with a Blood Drive
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi [NAME]
As a leader in your community, you can make a significant impact by hosting another Red Cross blood drive this fall.
September is National Sickle Cell Awareness Month and an ideal time to highlight the unique blood needs of individuals living with this genetic disease. It’s also important to emphasis how Black communities can help support these patients by bringing awareness to sickle cell disease and help through making a blood donation.
You can find more information at RedCrossBlood.org/OurBlood.
Please consider hosting a Red Cross blood drive in part of Joined by Blood, a focused time period within our Sickle Cell Initiative throughout the months of September and October.
Let’s get your blood drive scheduled! Please call me at XXX_XXX_XXXX or reply to this email.
Sincerely, [NAME]
